note: The two sets are nearly identical: 14 of 15 claims match exactly and all are correctly bound to their Wiring Schedule rows (150/151 and circuits 20, 31, 32, 33, 50), with quotes that support them. The only difference is the row-151 conductor claim: Set A states 'conductor quantity and size = 3#4/0', while Set B states a vaguer 'conductor = 3#4/0' with conditions AL and ARMORED CABLE that are already covered by its separate material and cable-type claims. Both sets omit the main-panel note facts (120/240V 1Ø 3W, 50A/2P main breaker, 200A/2P NFDS, NEMA 3R enclosure) and several row details (e.g., 150's 2-1/2"C., 31's 3/4"C., 50's #8G., rows 10 and 34).
remarks: Both extractions ignore the NOTES block above the schedule (main panel voltage/configuration, main breaker and NFDS ratings, NEMA 3R enclosure) — an important engineering fact both sets miss. Set B's row-151 'conductor' attribute is generic and its AL / ARMORED CABLE conditions duplicate its own separate claims for that row. Both add the unit 'AWG' to '#12G' for circuit 20, which is not written on the page (minor). The text layer garbles the panel note lines (e.g. 'MAIN BONDI', '00A/2P NFDS') and shows '3#10G.' for row 33 where the image reads '10G.'; the image is the clearer source for those items.
